plainText:
Summon the Emissaries of the Moon and the Sun (Japanese: 出現！！月と太陽の化身！ Arrival!! The Incarnations of the Moon and Sun!) is the 25th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Nebby and the other evolve into and , respectively.
A small army of Ultra Beasts converge at the Poni Altar, forcing everyone to fight them off.
confronts Faba about the island the Aether Foundation took from his late great-grandfather, only to find that the island was converted to Aether Paradise, making the five years Sun spent to gather money entirely pointless.
A 's hand emerges from an Ultra Wormhole and grabs Solgaleo, fusing with it.
The possessed Solgaleo grabs Sun and drags him into the wormhole with it while and Lunala chase after them.
Six months later, Lusamine is seen spending time with a group of Ultra Beasts on Poni Island.
